capture_functional_loss: sum over 24 GDN layers of functional_layer_loss / 24
capture_state_loss: sum over 24 GDN layers of state_layer_loss / 24
diagnostic_H1: one capture at token 31 of first 32 TRAIN tokens; no formal eight-capture divisor in the historical H1 diagnostic
formal_document_update: sum over eight frozen sampled capture positions of C5_or_C6_at_capture / 8, accumulated by segment before one Adam update
functional_layer_loss: sum over every element of (out_proj_student.float-out_proj_teacher.float)^2 divided by max(sum over every element of out_proj_teacher.float^2,1e-12)
rank0_local_C5: sum layer losses for GDN IDs 0..14 present on rank0 / 24 (not / 12)
rank1_local_C5: sum layer losses for GDN IDs 16..30 present on rank1 / 24 (not / 12)
state_layer_loss: mean over batch and heads of sum over K,V of (recover_state(student_prev,H,Delta)-teacher_prev)^2 divided by max(sum over K,V teacher_prev^2,1e-12)
